purpose: Combined Golden-100 + human-verified real-tender GOLD for automated RAG harness hooks.

semantics.human_priority: ACCEPT > REJECT > UNSURE evidence is checked before generic constraints for a returned LD id.
semantics.known_rejected_ids: Human-confirmed rejected candidates override the generic constraint judge.
semantics.known_unsure_ids: Human-uncertain candidates are not counted as PASS.
semantics.core: Hard-gate MATCHED cases with deterministic requirements and catalog existence evidence.
semantics.extended: Diagnostic-only cases with ambiguity, unsupported constraints, or unproven catalog existence.
semantics.pn: candidate PN must be >= query pn_min_mpa
semantics.bore_type: full|standard|reduced; standard execution of a ball valve means standard bore.
semantics.real_tender: Human-verified tender positives are non-exhaustive. They become hard gates only when the current deterministic requirement schema can judge an unseen returned product without relying on membership in the positive-id set.
